s1t: The two leaks every business has
s1s: It doesn't matter whether you sell consultations, food, houses, classes or spare parts. Money escapes through the same two places.
f1t: The customer wants to pay and can't
f1p: They ask for a price by message, you answer, you send your bank details, they think it over and cool off. Every extra step between intent and payment costs you sales.
f2t: The customer writes and nobody answers
f2p: They message you at eleven at night, on a Sunday, or while you're with someone else. Whoever waits more than a few minutes writes to the next business. That sale never comes back.

q1: Is the discount real or was the price inflated?
a1: It is real and it is for our opening. Forja Labs opens this month and needs real cases more than margin. After the month, prices return to list and it will not be repeated.
q2: What do I gain by paying in full?
a2: An extra 10% off, priority in the production queue, kick-off within 48 hours and one additional round of revisions.
q3: Is my business too small for this?
a3: If you already have customers who write to you, it isn't. The smaller the team, the heavier every unanswered message weighs.
q4: Where does my customers' money go?
a4: Into your own Stripe account, connected to your bank. Forja Labs never touches your payments.
q5: Can the agent make things up?
a5: It is trained on your real business information and told explicitly what it must not answer. When it doesn't know something, it says so and hands the conversation over. You approve the answers before it goes live.
q6: Will the agent scare my customers away?
a6: It introduces itself as an assistant, never pretends to be you, and hands over the moment there's a complaint or a negotiation. The real alternative isn't you replying instantly: it's nobody replying.
q7: Why does the agent have a monthly fee and the page doesn't?
a7: Because every conversation consumes AI and hosting that are paid month by month. Once delivered, the page consumes nothing.
q8: What if I don't like what I see?
a8: You see the design before we build anything. If there's no agreement at the proposal stage, the second 50% is never paid and that's where it ends.
